source_name: World Gold Council - Gold spot price (Market Data: ICE Data Services)
grams_basis: 1 troy ounce = 31.1034768 grams (standard conversion, not a market quote)
limitations: LBMA publishes tabulated historical prices only through the licensed MyLBMA portal; no free LBMA fix value was retrievable on 2026-10-22. The World Gold Council quote above is the citable alternative.
Spot quotes move continuously. Any melt calculation shown on this site is only valid as of the quote_date above.
This is not an appraisal. Melt value ignores labour, setting, diamonds, brand, duty and resale spread.

The moving header and chart are distinct panels. Retrieved on 2026-10-22; quote_date is null because neither the retrieval date nor the chart date establishes the header quote timestamp. See F-017 and explore/review/#inherited-quote-date.
quote_scope: Earlier WGC header observation, not live. Source quote-as-of timestamp unconfirmed. Chart as-of metadata is not silently assigned to its moving header.
